title: 第15章 世上有妖怪寻到宝贝第16章 血玉参
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 刀剑刺穿了狼王的喉咙，扎进泥地里。
温热的液体喷得刀上全是，甚至溅到了林夜的手上、身上。
狼王四肢无力地蹬了几下，最后彻底不动了。
随后它身上浮现两团只有林夜才看得到的光芒，一团绿色一团白色。
两团光芒飞速林夜的身体，系统通知同时弹出。
【猎杀即将化妖的狼王一只，获得自由属性点+20】
【获得天赋：寻宝（绿色），有概率感应到方圆五里以内天材地宝。】
【获得天赋：狼视（白色），增加视野，加强夜视和动态视力。】
惊喜来得太突然，林夜愣在原地足足三秒，才回过神。
居然是稀有的寻宝天赋！
有了这个，这世间的天材地宝，尽入他手！
随后他看向狼窟的方向，冥冥之中，似乎脑海里有一条线连接在那。
这种感觉难以描述，就像是脑袋里塞了个无线电接收器。
身后传来徐林后知后觉的惊叹声；
“叔，这狼特娘的绝对成精了，你刚瞧见没，那狼爪子上有红光！”
徐虎也感慨不已：
“这山里的野兽河里的鱼，活得久了或者有什么造化，就会变成精怪，我从军那会，城外也经常遇到些怪事。”
闻言，林夜脑袋里突然灵光一闪。
等等！
刚才系统播报我杀了什么来着？
即将……化妖的狼王？
林夜死死盯着眼前巨大的狼尸，感觉整个世界观都被颠覆了。
敢情他老娘动不动念叨什么山精野怪的，居然是真的？
那会口吐人言的山君，是不是也是真的？
他浑身一激灵，回过神来，捡起备用的桦木弓，朝着陷阱坑的位置走去。
甭管什么妖怪不要怪的，先赶紧把属性点收了。
坑里还有三头奄奄一息的狼，被他干脆利落地解决。
两只给了4点属性，一只给了3点。
加上剩余的和狼王给的，一共28点。
林夜加了2点力量3点体质，三维属性来到15、14、11。
一股热气从肚子里涌了上来，气力恢复些许，胸腔里也舒服多了。
他回头瞧见徐林徐虎已经开始收拾狼尸，于是一个人朝着洞窟走去。
狼窟里一股腐败的臭味，里面光线很暗。
狼视天赋发挥最用，很快昏暗的山洞在他眼前亮如白昼。

;;
The sword pierced the Wolf King's throat and plunged into the mud.
The warm liquid sprayed all over the knife and even splashed on Lin Ye's hands and body.
The Wolf King kicked weakly a few times, and finally stopped moving completely.
Then two balls of light that only Lin Ye could see appeared on it, one green and one white.
Two balls of light flew across Lin Ye's body, and system notifications popped up at the same time.
[Hunt a wolf king who is about to turn into a demon and gain free attribute points +20]
[Get talent: Treasure Hunting (green), there is a chance to sense the treasures of heaven, material and earth within a radius of five miles. 】
[Acquire talent: Wolf Vision (white), increase field of vision, strengthen night vision and dynamic vision. 】
The surprise came so suddenly that Lin Ye froze on the spot for three seconds before coming back to his senses.
It’s actually a rare treasure hunting talent!
With this, all the treasures in this world are in his hands!
Then he looked in the direction of the wolf den, and there seemed to be a line connecting it in his mind.
The feeling is indescribable, like having a radio receiver stuck in your head.
Xu Lin’s belated exclamation came from behind;
"Uncle, this wolf girl is definitely a sperm. Did you just see that there is a red light on the wolf's claws?"
Xu Hu was also filled with emotion:
"The beasts in the mountains and the fish in the river will turn into monsters if they live for a long time or have some luck. When I joined the army, I often encountered strange things outside the city."
Hearing this, Lin Ye suddenly had an idea flash in his head.
etc!
What did the system report I killed just now?
The Wolf King who is about to... turn into a demon?
Lin Ye stared at the huge wolf corpse in front of him, feeling that his entire world view had been subverted.
How dare he talk about mountain spirits and wild monsters all the time, but it’s true?
Is that tiger who can talk people's words real?
He was shocked, came to his senses, picked up the spare birch bow, and walked towards the trap pit.
Don't worry about the monsters, just collect the attribute points first.
There were three dying wolves in the pit, but he dealt with them neatly.
Two gave 4 attribute points, and one gave 3 points.
Including the remaining ones and those given by the Wolf King, there are a total of 28 points.
Lin Ye added 2 points of strength and 3 points of constitution, and his three-dimensional attributes reached 15, 14, and 11.
A wave of heat surged up from my stomach, my strength recovered a little, and my chest felt much better.
He turned around and saw that Xu Lin and Xu Hu had already begun to collect the wolf corpses, so he walked towards the cave alone.
There was a rotten smell in the wolf's den, and the light inside was very dark.
The gift of wolf vision was at its best, and soon the dim cave became as bright as day in front of his eyes.
